# Constants (edit everything here)
```{r define-constants}
#Run control
RUN_MODE      <- "compute"  #"compute" = cluster + write CSVs + plot; "plot" = read existing CSVs + plot only
SKIP_EXISTING <- TRUE       #compute mode: skip datasets whose Calinski_Harabasz CSV already exists

if (!RUN_MODE %in% c("compute", "plot")) stop('RUN_MODE must be "compute" or "plot"')

#Analysis settings
SEED <- 12345

#Cumulative GPS score thresholds (%)
THRESHOLDS <- seq(10, 100, by = 2)
PLOT_X_RANGE <- c(10, 50) #Plot x-axis range

#Louvain clustering settings
LOUVAIN_RESOLUTION <- 0.8
KNN_K              <- 20

#Top genes exported as count matrix subsets
TOP_N <- 100

#Directories
INPUT_DIR  <- here("Filtered_Input")                     #where to find count matrices
SCORE_DIR  <- here("Data_Hold", "Gene_Scores")           #<name>_gene_scores.csv (GPS + HVG dispersion)
OUT_ROOT   <- here("Calinski_Harabasz")                  #each dataset is saved in <OUT_ROOT> for plots
EXPORT_DIR <- here("Data_Hold", "Subset_Counts")         #where TOP-N count matrix subsets go
CALIN_DIR  <- here("Data_Hold", "Calinski_Harabasz")     #<name>_Calinski_Harabasz.csv tables

#Gene score file columns
SCORE_SUFFIX <- "_gene_scores.csv"
GENE_COL     <- "Gene"
PG_COL       <- "GPS"
HVG_COL      <- "HVG_Dispersion"

#Plot appearance
FONT_FAMILY     <- "Arial"
LEGEND_POSITION <- c(1, 1)  #cartesian coordiates. Range from 0 to 1
PLOT_DPI        <- 300
PLOT_WIDTH      <- 5 #inches
PLOT_HEIGHT     <- 4

COL_PG    <- "#1BB7D8"
COL_HVG   <- "#E55B1E"
COL_UNION <- "#2C9F45"

#Datasets to run: name (used as output folder, file prefix, and score file prefix) = input CSV filename
#Comment out a line to skip that dataset
datasets <- c( PBMC12K              = "PBMC12K_Counts.csv"
)

#Datasets whose plots show a legend (use character(0) for none)
LEGEND_DATASETS <- c(
    "TabulaMuris_Lung"
    , "TabulaMuris_Liver"
    , "Human_Primary_Motor_Cortex"
    , "Human_Intestines"
    , "PBMC12K"
)
```

# Functions
## Paths
```{r define-functions-paths}
#<CALIN_DIR>/<name>_Calinski_Harabasz.csv (vectorized over name)
calin_path <- function(name) file.path(CALIN_DIR, paste0(name, "_Calinski_Harabasz.csv"))
```

## Loading and scoring
```{r define-functions-scoring}
#Read a count matrix's CSV and standardize gene/cell names
load_dataset <- function(path) {
  counts <- read.csv(path, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
  rownames(counts) <- gsub("-", "_", rownames(counts))
  colnames(counts) <- gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(counts))
  counts
}

#Read a gene score CSV and return both rankings
#  pg_scores: named numeric vector of GPS, sorted descending (names = genes)
#  hvgs:      character vector of genes sorted by HVG dispersion, descending
load_gene_scores <- function(path, counts) {
  scores <- read.csv(path, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  needed <- c(GENE_COL, PG_COL, HVG_COL)
  absent <- setdiff(needed, colnames(scores))
  if (length(absent)) {
    stop(basename(path), " is missing column(s): ", paste(absent, collapse = ", "))
  }

  scores[[GENE_COL]] <- gsub("-", "_", scores[[GENE_COL]])

  if (anyDuplicated(scores[[GENE_COL]])) {
    warning(basename(path), ": duplicate gene names found; keeping first occurrence")
    scores <- scores[!duplicated(scores[[GENE_COL]]), ]
  }

  not_in_counts <- setdiff(scores[[GENE_COL]], rownames(counts))
  if (length(not_in_counts)) {
    warning(basename(path), ": ", length(not_in_counts),
            " scored genes not found in count matrix; they stay in the ranking ",
            "but are skipped during clustering")
  }

  #Principal Genes ranking (GPS, descending)
  pg <- scores[!is.na(scores[[PG_COL]]), ]
  pg <- pg[order(pg[[PG_COL]], decreasing = TRUE), ]
  pg_scores <- setNames(pg[[PG_COL]], pg[[GENE_COL]])

  #HVG ranking (dispersion, descending; NAs last)
  hvg  <- scores[order(scores[[HVG_COL]], decreasing = TRUE, na.last = TRUE), ]
  hvgs <- hvg[[GENE_COL]]

  list(pg_scores = pg_scores, hvgs = hvgs)
}

#Walk down the ranked Principal Genes and record the gene count at which each cumulative score threshold
select_threshold_genes <- function(top_genes, thresholds) {
  cum_score <- cumsum(top_genes * 100)
  idx <- integer(0)
  t <- 1
  for (i in seq_along(cum_score)) {
    if (cum_score[i] >= thresholds[t]) {
      idx[t] <- i
      t <- t + 1
      if (t > length(thresholds)) break
    }
  }
  if (!length(idx)) stop("No cumulative score threshold was reached")
  if (length(idx) < length(thresholds)) {
    message("Only ", length(idx), " of ", length(thresholds),
            " thresholds reached; highest is ", thresholds[length(idx)], "%")
  }

  list(thresholds = thresholds[seq_along(idx)],
       num_genes  = idx,
       gene_sets  = lapply(idx, function(n) names(top_genes)[seq_len(n)]))
}

#Save the raw counts subset to only top genes
#<EXPORT_DIR>/<name>_<method>_subset_<TOP_N>.csv
save_top_subset <- function(counts, genes, name, method) {
  missing <- setdiff(genes, rownames(counts))
  if (length(missing)) {
    warning(name, " ", method, ": ", length(missing),
            " genes not found in counts and left out: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  }
  genes <- intersect(genes, rownames(counts))
  write.csv(counts[genes, , drop = FALSE],
            file.path(EXPORT_DIR, paste0(name, "_", method, "_subset_", TOP_N, ".csv")))
}
```

## Clustering and Calinski-Harabasz
```{r define-functions-clustering}

cluster_and_score <- function(dat, gene_names, resolution = LOUVAIN_RESOLUTION,
                              k.param = KNN_K, seed = SEED) {

  #Only genes present in the count matrix can be clustered on
  gene_names <- intersect(gene_names, rownames(dat))

  m <- as.matrix(t(log2(dat[gene_names, , drop = FALSE] + 1)))

  #Drop NA columns and all-zero cells
  m <- m[, colSums(is.na(m)) == 0, drop = FALSE]
  m <- m[rowSums(m) != 0, , drop = FALSE]
  m_norm <- m / sqrt(rowSums(m^2))

  # kNN -> snn graph (rann for reproducibility)
  k.param <- min(k.param, nrow(m_norm) - 1)
  graphs <- FindNeighbors(m_norm, k.param = k.param, compute.SNN = TRUE,
                          nn.method = "rann", verbose = FALSE)

  louv <- FindClusters(graphs$snn, resolution = resolution, algorithm = 1,
                       random.seed = seed, verbose = FALSE)
  clusters <- as.integer(louv[[1]])
  names(clusters) <- rownames(louv)  #keep cell names
  clusters <- clusters[rownames(m)]

  n_clust <- length(unique(clusters))
  if (n_clust < 2) {
    warning("Louvain returned a single cluster; Calinski-Harabasz set to NA")
    return(list(clusters = clusters, n_clusters = n_clust, calin = NA))
  }

  list(
    clusters   = clusters,
    n_clusters = n_clust,
    calin      = calinhara(m, clusters)
  )
}

#Cluster on each gene set in a list
cluster_gene_sets <- function(counts, gene_sets, label) {
  lapply(seq_along(gene_sets), function(i) {
    res <- cluster_and_score(counts, gene_sets[[i]])
    message(label, " set ", i, " (", length(gene_sets[[i]]), " genes): ",
            res$n_clusters, " clusters")
    res
  })
}

#Pull one numeric field out of a list of clustering results
pluck_num <- function(res, field) sapply(res, function(r) as.numeric(r[[field]]))

#One row per threshold with Calinski-Harabasz and cluster counts
build_metrics_df <- function(sel, pg, hvg, union, union_sets) {
  data.frame(
    thresholds         = sel$thresholds,
    num_genes          = sel$num_genes,
    union_num_genes    = lengths(union_sets),
    PG_calin           = pluck_num(pg,    "calin"),
    HVG_calin          = pluck_num(hvg,   "calin"),
    PG_HVG_Union_calin = pluck_num(union, "calin"),
    PG_nclust          = pluck_num(pg,    "n_clusters"),
    HVG_nclust         = pluck_num(hvg,   "n_clusters"),
    Union_nclust       = pluck_num(union, "n_clusters")
  )
}
```

## Plotting and saving
```{r define-functions-plots}
#Shared plot theme
base_theme <- function(show_legend = FALSE) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10, base_family = FONT_FAMILY) +
    theme(
      legend.position             = if (show_legend) "inside" else "none",
      legend.position.inside      = LEGEND_POSITION,
      legend.justification.inside = LEGEND_POSITION,
      legend.box.margin           = margin(4, 4, 4, 4),
      legend.title                = element_blank(),
      legend.background           = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.8), colour = NA)
    )
}

#Save a plot as TIFF and JPG
save_plot <- function(plot, out_dir, name, suffix,
                      width = PLOT_WIDTH, height = PLOT_HEIGHT) {
  stem <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, "_", suffix))

  ggsave(filename = paste0(stem, ".tif"), plot = plot, dpi = PLOT_DPI,
         width = width, height = height, units = "in",
         device = "tiff", compression = "lzw", type = "cairo", bg = "white")

  ggsave(filename = paste0(stem, ".jpg"), plot = plot, dpi = PLOT_DPI,
         width = width, height = height, units = "in",
         device = "jpeg", quality = 100, type = "cairo", bg = "white")
}

# Three series across thresholds. num_col is labeled with num_genes (below,
# blue) and union_col with union_num_genes (above, green).
# x_range sets the x-axis limits; points outside it are dropped and the trend
# line is fitted to the visible points only (NULL shows the full range).
threshold_plot <- function(df, cols, legend_labels, colors, num_col, union_col,
                           y_lab, show_legend = FALSE, x_range = PLOT_X_RANGE) {
  long <- df %>%
    pivot_longer(all_of(cols), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = cols))

  g <- ggplot(long, aes(x = thresholds, y = value, color = metric)) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_text(data = filter(long, metric == num_col), aes(label = num_genes),
              color = COL_PG, vjust = 2, size = 3, family = FONT_FAMILY,
              check_overlap = TRUE) +
    geom_text(data = filter(long, metric == union_col), aes(label = union_num_genes),
              color = "darkgreen", vjust = -2, size = 3, family = FONT_FAMILY,
              check_overlap = TRUE) +
    labs(x = "Cumulative GPS Threshold (%)", y = y_lab) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = x_range) +
    scale_color_manual(breaks = cols,
                       values = setNames(colors, cols),
                       labels = setNames(legend_labels, cols)) +
    base_theme(show_legend)

  # skip the trend line when too few thresholds were reached
  if (nrow(df) >= 4) {
    g <- g + geom_smooth(method = "loess", formula = y ~ x,
                         method.args = list(span = 1, degree = 1, surface = "direct"),
                         se = FALSE)
  }
  g
}

#Plot one dataset's Calinski-Harabasz results and save directly to <OUT_ROOT>/
plot_dataset <- function(name, metrics_df, show_legend = FALSE) {
  dir.create(OUT_ROOT, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  calin_cols <- c("PG_calin", "HVG_calin", "PG_HVG_Union_calin")
  needed <- c("thresholds", "num_genes", "union_num_genes", calin_cols)
  absent <- setdiff(needed, colnames(metrics_df))
  if (length(absent)) {
    stop(name, " CSV is missing column(s): ", paste(absent, collapse = ", "))
  }

  p <- threshold_plot(metrics_df, calin_cols,
                      c("Principal Genes", "Seurat's HVG", "HVG_PG_Union"),
                      c(COL_PG, COL_HVG, COL_UNION),
                      num_col = calin_cols[1], union_col = calin_cols[3],
                      y_lab = "Calinski-Harabasz Index", show_legend = show_legend)
  print(p)
  save_plot(p, OUT_ROOT, name, "PG_HVG_UNION_CalinskiHarabasz")
  invisible(p)
}
```

## Compute pipeline for one dataset
```{r define-functions-pipeline}
#Clusters one dataset and writes <CALIN_DIR>/<name>_Calinski_Harabasz.csv (no plotting)
run_dataset <- function(name, path, score_path) {
  #Load counts and precomputed gene scores
  counts    <- load_dataset(path)
  scores    <- load_gene_scores(score_path, counts)
  pg_scores <- scores$pg_scores
  hvgs      <- scores$hvgs

  #Count matrices subset to each method's top TOP_N genes
  save_top_subset(counts, names(head(pg_scores, TOP_N)), name, "PG")
  save_top_subset(counts, head(hvgs, TOP_N),             name, "HVG")

  #Gene sets at each cumulative score threshold
  sel        <- select_threshold_genes(pg_scores, THRESHOLDS)
  hvg_sets   <- lapply(sel$num_genes, function(n) head(hvgs, n))
  union_sets <- Map(union, sel$gene_sets, hvg_sets)

  #Louvain clustering on each gene set
  pg_res    <- cluster_gene_sets(counts, sel$gene_sets, "PG")
  hvg_res   <- cluster_gene_sets(counts, hvg_sets,      "HVG")
  union_res <- cluster_gene_sets(counts, union_sets,    "Union")

  #Calinski-Harabasz across thresholds
  metrics_df <- build_metrics_df(sel, pg_res, hvg_res, union_res, union_sets)
  write.csv(metrics_df, calin_path(name), row.names = FALSE)

  invisible(metrics_df)
}
```

# Compute (RUN_MODE = "compute")
```{r compute}
if (RUN_MODE == "compute") {
  dir.create(EXPORT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(CALIN_DIR,  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  #Skip datasets that already have a Calinski_Harabasz CSV
  to_run <- names(datasets)
  if (SKIP_EXISTING) {
    done <- to_run[file.exists(calin_path(to_run))]
    if (length(done)) {
      message("Calinski_Harabasz CSV exists, skipping: ", paste(done, collapse = ", "))
    }
    to_run <- setdiff(to_run, done)
  }

  if (!length(to_run)) {
    message("Nothing to compute; all datasets already have CSVs.")
  } else {
    #Check input and score files exist (only for datasets being computed)
    input_paths <- setNames(file.path(INPUT_DIR, datasets[to_run]), to_run)
    score_paths <- setNames(file.path(SCORE_DIR, paste0(to_run, SCORE_SUFFIX)), to_run)

    missing_counts <- datasets[to_run][!file.exists(input_paths)]
    missing_scores <- basename(score_paths)[!file.exists(score_paths)]
    if (length(missing_counts) || length(missing_scores)) {
      stop(
        if (length(missing_counts))
          paste0("Missing count files in ", INPUT_DIR, ": ",
                 paste(missing_counts, collapse = ", "), "\n"),
        if (length(missing_scores))
          paste0("Missing score files in ", SCORE_DIR, ": ",
                 paste(missing_scores, collapse = ", "))
      )
    }

    status <- character(0)
    for (name in to_run) {
      message("==================== ", name, " ====================")
      status[name] <- tryCatch({
        run_dataset(name, input_paths[[name]], score_paths[[name]])
        "success"
      }, error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
      invisible(gc())
    }

    # Summary
    failed <- status[status != "success"]
    if (length(failed)) {
      message("Failed datasets:")
      for (n in names(failed)) message("  ", n, ": ", failed[[n]])
    } else {
      message("All ", length(status), " datasets computed.")
    }
  }
}
```

# Plot (runs in both modes, reads from CSVs)
```{r plot}
for (name in names(datasets)) {
  path <- calin_path(name)
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    message("No Calinski_Harabasz CSV for ", name, ", skipping plot")
    next
  }

  tryCatch({
    metrics_df <- read.csv(path, check.names = FALSE)
    plot_dataset(name, metrics_df, show_legend = name %in% LEGEND_DATASETS)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Plot FAILED for ", name, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
  })
}
```
